Generated Narrative: StructureDefinition EHDSDosage

NameFlagsCard.TypeDescription & Constraints
EHDSDosage 0..*BaseDosage model
EHDSDosage.renderedDosageInstruction 0..1stringFull dosage information as human-readable text covering all dosage steps. Generating the text shall follow local rules and shall include all locally implemented dosage data even when such elements are not present in this model.
EHDSDosage.dosageDetails 0..*BaseDetails of the step in a single dosage scheme.
EHDSDosage.dosageDetails.sequence 0..1integerOrder of the dosage instruction, if one treatment consists of several dosage steps. When two schemes share the same sequence number, they are meant to run in parallel.
EHDSDosage.dosageDetails.note 0..1stringPatient-oriented instructions as free text for this dosage step.
EHDSDosage.dosageDetails.doseAndRate 0..*BaseAmount of medicinal product administered per dose (= one timing).
EHDSDosage.dosageDetails.doseAndRate.dose[x] 0..1Amount of medicinal product per one dose (1 tablet, 2-3 tablets, 20 ml).
Binding Description: (required) ⚠: UCUM (units of measurement), EDQM Standard Terms (units of presentation)
EHDSDosage.dosageDetails.doseAndRate.dose[x].doseQuantityQuantity
EHDSDosage.dosageDetails.doseAndRate.dose[x].doseRangeRange
EHDSDosage.dosageDetails.doseAndRate.rate[x] 0..1Amount of medicinal product per time period (e.g. 100 mg per hour). When rate is provided per time unit, Quantity data type may be used with a suitable unit (e.g. mg/h, μg/min.).
Binding Description: (required) ⚠: UCUM (units of measurement), EDQM Standard Terms (units of presentation)
EHDSDosage.dosageDetails.doseAndRate.rate[x].rateQuantityQuantity
EHDSDosage.dosageDetails.doseAndRate.rate[x].rateRatioRatio
EHDSDosage.dosageDetails.repeat 0..1BaseRepetition of the administration.
EHDSDosage.dosageDetails.repeat.bounds[x] 0..1Time bounds for the treatment (current dosage scheme), Quantity contains a number of time units (e.g. 10 days), Period contains start and end date (e.g. 5.8.2023-10.8.2023).
EHDSDosage.dosageDetails.repeat.bounds[x].boundsQuantityQuantity
EHDSDosage.dosageDetails.repeat.bounds[x].boundsPeriodPeriod
EHDSDosage.dosageDetails.repeat.duration 0..1QuantityDuration of administration (e.g. ‘five minutes’, ‘one hour’).
Binding Description: (required) ⚠: UCUM (units of measurement)
EHDSDosage.dosageDetails.repeat.frequency 0..1BaseFrequency of intake/administration.
EHDSDosage.dosageDetails.repeat.frequency.numberOfTimes 0..1integerNumber of times per period (e.g. ‘three times’).
EHDSDosage.dosageDetails.repeat.frequency.period 0..1QuantityDuration to which the frequency applies (e.g. ‘… / one day’).
Binding Description: (required) ⚠: UCUM (units of measurement)
EHDSDosage.dosageDetails.repeat.dayOfWeek 0..*CodeableConceptThe day of the week of administration, e.g. Mon., Tue.
Binding Description: (required) ⚠: HL7 Days Of Week
EHDSDosage.dosageDetails.repeat.timeOfDay 0..*timeExact time of day of administration (e.g. ‘10:00’).
EHDSDosage.dosageDetails.repeat.eventTime 0..*CodeableConceptTime period or event when the administration shall happen (‘before meal’, ‘immediately’, ‘morning’).
Binding Description: (required) ⚠: HL7 Event Timing
EHDSDosage.dosageDetails.asNeeded 0..1booleanTake as needed.
EHDSDosage.dosageDetails.bodySite 0..1EHDSBodyStructureBody site of administration.
EHDSDosage.dosageDetails.routeOfAdministration 0..1CodeableConceptRoute of administration.
Binding Description: (required) ⚠: EDQM Standard Terms
